title: がんばれのきもち (Ganbare no Kimochi)
description: At sports day, Mei runs the relay race as hard as she can — but her team finishes last. She feels a swirl of disappointment, embarrassment, and frustration all at once. Through a kind word from a classmate and the gentle untangling of her feelings, Mei discovers she can feel sad about losing and proud of her effort at the same time.
author: オリジナル
